newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC says changes balance date to Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: WMC says changes balance date to Dec 31.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Wednesday that it and its subsidiaries would change their financial year end to December 31 from June 30 and would have an 18-month transitional accounting period from July 1, 1997 to December 31, 1998.

WMC said its major non wholly-owned equity interests, particularly Alcoa World Alumina and Chemicals, have a December year. "Our current 30 June year end accounts are, therefore, produced using information from these equity interests which have not been audited for their last half year," WMC said.
"The change will mean all of the company's businesses will share the same financial year end," the company said.

The miner said its 1998 annual report, for the 18-month period ending December 31, 1998, would be published in March 1999 and the annual meeting, which would have been held in November 1998 would be held in Melbourne in April 1999.
